description_en: deep traditional grain-carrying basket with woven body and a broad asymmetrical rim; front pouring lip, right side cord handle, rear reinforced tall wall
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image is the canonical FRONT. Render ONE photorealistic REAR azimuth180, opposite face of THAT EXACT SAME OBJECT, rotating only the camera. High reinforced rear wall nearest camera, low front pouring lip on opposite far side, existing cord handle now image-left. Keep exact material, finish, weave, dimensions, bindings, handles, cavities and natural resting/display pose of the reference. Match sensible elevation, warm-white seamless background, soft light, scale and framing. Whole object centered with margins. No three-quarter azimuth, mirroring, detached objects, props, people, food, animals or plants. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermark or measurements.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
